interpretation: The listener extended the same verdict to the Deflektor package: no audible difference between the exact low-byte PWM transfer and the SID-Wizard PWSWEEP variant.
scope: Deflektor familiar transfer (53 Für Elise notes, records 6/3/7), phrase and ending, rendered with libsidplayfp for MOS8580/PAL at unit gain.
